title: Discrimination of the deployed model
caption: AP (average precision) is the area under the precision-recall curve; it is the primary metric because churners are 27% of customers.

title: Cumulative gains

population: 1,409 test customers, held out from every choice

caption: Dashed lines: 75th percentiles of risk and value, fitted on validation and frozen. Value = margin x discounted remaining months.

title: Who each rule contacts
caption: Value at risk = sum of churn probability x customer value in the quadrant.
population: 1,409 test customers, held out from every choice

title: Strategy comparison at the fixed budget
caption: Expected value under the stated save-rate and cost assumptions; not realised profit.
population: 1,409 test customers, held out from every choice

title: Profit curve and marginal ROI
caption: Recommendation chosen on validation (largest budget whose last step still clears the hurdle) and shown here on test.
population: 1,409 test customers, held out from every choice

title: One-way sensitivity (tornado)

title: Save rate x offer cost sensitivity
caption: Frozen vs re-optimised list.

title: Allocation audit by protected attribute
caption: Gender and SeniorCitizen are not model inputs; they are used only for this audit.
population: 1,409 test customers, held out from every choice

title: Deployed model drivers
caption:
Calibrated logistic model. Categories vs their lowest-churn level, flags vs not having the service,
tenure per 12 months. Associations, not causes.

title: Challenger model SHAP
caption: TreeSHAP on 200 validation customers; explains the raw XGBoost challenger, not the deployed calibrated logistic model.

title: Why churners left
caption: Reason categories as grouped by IBM; recorded after customers left, so descriptive only, never a model input.
population: all 1,869 churners in the IBM extended sample; list churners from the test split

title: Outside the sample
caption:
Probabilities shifted to lower average churn with ranks unchanged; Vietnam-like prices scale bills and offers to a 250,000 VND bill
and contact by SMS. Value horizon held fixed. Contact cap applies.
population: 1,409 test customers, held out from every choice

title: Joint uncertainty of the assumptions
caption:
5,000 draws; every register assumption drawn at once from a triangular distribution (low, base, high).
Lists and offers are frozen, as they would be in a pilot; shaded area = loss; the most extreme 0.2% at each end are not drawn.
population: 1,409 test customers, held out from every choice

title: Target profile
caption: Share of customers with each attribute, on the recommended list and among all test customers.
population: 1,409 test customers, held out from every choice
